diagnosis.repair_strategy: harden exporter to validate and report per_layer_input_runtime before writing a component pack; harden native validation so malformed per_layer_input_runtime sections fail with the same deterministic field.

implemented_boundary.new_exporter_contract: decoder_manifest.json must include top-level per_layer_input_runtime.roles for PLE token, projection norm, and projection tensors plus architecture_config.per_layer_input_runtime_source.
implemented_boundary.new_native_contract: missing or malformed per_layer_input_runtime.roles fails closed as decoder_manifest_per_layer_input_runtime_missing before runtime proceeds.

source_changes.summary: Adds validate_decoder_manifest_contract, requires the PLE runtime roles and architecture runtime source, fails closed with metadata before writing an incomplete component pack, and records manifest_contract_checks in export_report.json.
Scopes PLE key checks to the top-level per_layer_input_runtime object and rejects missing or malformed roles with decoder_manifest_per_layer_input_runtime_missing.
Adds exporter contract assertions for manifest_contract_checks and a fail-closed regression for missing per_layer_input_runtime.
Adds native regression coverage for malformed per_layer_input_runtime preserving no-prediction behavior.
